title: MOSOKO_Punjabi_Sat_Sri_Akal_627f1b1f
style: Bhangra-pop fusion featuring a mix of traditional Punjabi elements and modern electronic production. The track is driven by a prominent dhol drum pattern and a syncopated acoustic guitar strumming rhythm. A bright, melodic synth lead plays a repetitive hook. Male vocals are clear and energetic, alternating between English and Punjabi. The arrangement includes a deep synth bass that follows the kick drum. Tempo is 100 BPM in the key of G Major. The production uses clean digital reverb on the vocals and sharp, punchy percussion hits.
